source.author: verg
source.text: verum ipsae e foliis natos, e suavibus herbis ore legunt, ipsae regem parvosque Quirites sufficiunt aulasque et cerea regna refigunt.
source.text_original: verum ipsae e foliis natos, e suavibus herbis / ore legunt, ipsae regem parvosque Quirites / sufficiunt aulasque et cerea regna refigunt.
source.text_english: Yet they themselves gather from the leaves and sweet herbs those born of them with their mouths; they themselves rear a king and little citizens, and they unbar their chambers and waxen kingdoms.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nam si quibusdam minutis animalibus id praestitit, ut sibi e foliis natos et suauibus herbis ore legant, cur existimet aliquis ipsum deum nisi ex permixtione sexus alterius non posse generare?
reuse.text_original: nam si quibusdam minutis animalibus id praestitit, ut sibi e foliis natos et suauibus herbis ore legant, cur existimet aliquis ipsum deum nisi ex permixtione sexus alterius non posse generare?
reuse.text_english: For if he granted this to certain tiny creatures, that they themselves gather from the leaves and sweet herbs the beings born to them with their mouths, why should anyone think that God himself cannot bring forth offspring except by the mingling of another sex?
